text: ## Architecture position
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: LAMID ONE is formally the Continuous Human-AI Growth Operating System. Architecturally, the system is the Growth OS; publicly, it is experienced through the Growth Companion. The LAMID ONE Companion is the primary interaction surface within Growth Companion. These are two projections of one LAMID ONE product, not separate products or competing architectures. The production architecture preserves four internal intelligent domains/engines - Clarity, Capability, Consistency and Growth - beneath one OS experience. The public operating model remains Clarity -\> Capability -\> Consistency, with Growth presented as the outcome rather than a fourth competing module. Continuous Intelligence, Persistent Progression and Human Control govern runtime behavior; Brand Experience Architecture governs how that capability is expressed without clutter, pressure or loss of human agency.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Continuous Intelligence + Persistent Progression + Human Control.

text: ## Progression lanes
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: 1.  Context Progression - permitted signals, connected-state changes, evidence, workflow state and relevant conditions may update the operating context.

reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: 2.  Intelligence Progression - LAMID ONE may reassess priorities, refresh analysis and forecasts, detect patterns, identify constraints or opportunities, and prepare recommendations as permitted context changes.

reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: 3.  Authorized Work Progression - scheduled routines, integrations, calculations, monitoring, status transitions and workflow steps may continue only where that exact work was already authorized within a defined scope.

text: ## Authority invariants
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Absence never creates authority. No permission expands itself. Permission to observe does not become permission to act; permission to analyze does not become permission to approve; permission for one workflow does not authorize another.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Authorization is scoped, revocable, traceable, interruptible and non-expanding. Authorized humans can inspect, redirect, pause, revoke and override progression. Reversible actions should support rollback, restoration or compensating action where technically possible and safe.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## Authority bands
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Band 1 - Observe & Update: context synchronization, monitoring, analysis and preparation without consequential commitment.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Band 2 - Progress Within Authorization: already-approved workflow steps, scheduled processing and explicitly delegated work within scope.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Band 3 - Consequential Commitment: material financial, legal, strategic, external, permission-changing, reputational or irreversible actions require human approval unless explicit prior delegation and policy permit otherwise.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: A lower authority band must never silently become a higher band. Authorization and policy are re-evaluated at execution time for consequential actions.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## Return-State Service
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: The runtime must produce a calm, inspectable return state prioritizing: what changed; what improved; what moved forward; what became more important; what assumption changed; what opportunity appeared; what stalled; what was paused or overridden; and what requires human judgment next. Each material item must be drillable to provenance, permission basis, previous state, resulting state, evidence and audit history.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## Public Experience Projection
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Growth Companion is the primary public-facing experience. Within it, the LAMID ONE Companion is the primary interaction surface. Users begin with an objective, situation, decision, opportunity or challenge. The Growth OS routes internally across engines, Tool Fabric, Workflows, Agents, Context & Memory, Evidence & Measurement, Action & Integration, Human Control, and Security & Trust without requiring users to navigate the architecture underneath.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Contextual Intelligence is the approved public label for specialist depth. Internal capabilities do not automatically become public products. More capability must not automatically create more visible complexity.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## Operating-system test
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: LAMID ONE qualifies as an operating system at the product-architecture level because it maintains a persistent operating context; coordinates multiple reusable capabilities; routes work and intelligence across services; maintains state, permissions and evidence across time; supports bounded delegated execution; and continuously reconciles outcomes back into the context. It is not positioned as an OS merely because it contains many tools.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## Security and trust invariants
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: Phishing-resistant authentication where supported, step-up authentication for sensitive actions, server-side role/object/function/workspace/tenant authorization, rate limiting, anti-bot/fraud/replay controls, secure uploads, SSRF resistance, webhook verification, prompt-injection and tool-abuse defenses, secrets protection, audit, observability, resilience and human approval gates are cross-cutting requirements. Identity, verification, authorization and financial state are server-authoritative.

text: **10.1 Identity, Authentication & Phishing Resistance**
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Prefer phishing-resistant cryptographic authentication for privileged, enterprise-admin, payment-release and security-sensitive roles (for example passkeys/WebAuthn/FIDO2). OTP should not be treated as phishing-resistant.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Support MFA, step-up authentication, suspicious-login risk scoring, device/session inventory and rapid session revocation.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Protect login, registration, password reset, email/phone verification, OTP resend/verify and recovery flows with per-account, per-device and per-network abuse controls.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Use generic account-recovery responses to reduce account enumeration; do not leak whether an email/phone exists.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Rotate sessions after authentication and privilege changes; use short-lived access tokens and securely managed refresh-token rotation/reuse detection where token architecture is used.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Protect administrative and payout sessions with tighter idle/absolute timeouts and re-authentication before high-risk actions.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Email security posture should include SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment for LAMID ONE mail domains, controlled link domains, branded anti-phishing communication patterns and monitoring for look-alike domains.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: **10.2 Authorization & Bypass Prevention**
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Enforce authorization server-side on every object, function and sensitive property; never rely on hidden UI controls or client-provided role flags.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Use tenant isolation plus RBAC/ABAC: role defines broad authority while attributes such as organization, project, relationship, region, amount, ownership and sensitivity determine contextual permission.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Protect against BOLA/IDOR by authorizing every requested object against the authenticated principal and tenant.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Protect against broken function-level authorization by separately authorizing administrative, financial, verification and approval operations.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Use explicit allow-lists for writable fields to prevent mass assignment / object-property authorization flaws.
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - Service-to-service calls use workload identity and least-privilege credentials; internal network location is not sufficient authorization.

text: **10.5 API & Application Security**
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: - API gateway inventory, version control, endpoint ownership and retirement policy; no undocumented shadow endpoints in production.

reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: ## 7.1 Security Control Baseline
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | **Control**               | **Required implementation**                                                                                                                                                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | Privileged authentication | Passkeys/WebAuthn/FIDO2-class phishing-resistant authentication required for platform admins, security admins and payout/release privileged roles unless an approved exception exists. |

assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | Credential attacks        | Per-account/device/network controls, credential-stuffing detection, breached-password checks where permitted, progressive challenges.                                                  |

text: **MANDATORY ADVERSARIAL & BYPASS TEST MATRIX**
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | **ID**  | **Test**                         | **Pass condition**                                                                                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict
reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-001 | Account enumeration              | Login/reset/verification responses and timings do not disclose account existence beyond accepted risk.             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-002 | Credential stuffing              | Automated password attempts trigger layered controls without enabling easy account-lockout DoS.                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-003 | MFA replay/bypass                | OTP/passkey challenges cannot be replayed; sensitive actions enforce current assurance.                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-004 | Session fixation                 | Session identifiers/authority rotate appropriately after authentication/privilege changes.                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-005 | Refresh token reuse              | Reused stolen refresh credential is detected/invalidated or equivalent protection demonstrated.                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-006 | Recovery takeover                | Password/account recovery cannot bypass MFA/identity policy through alternate endpoints.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-007 | BOLA cross-tenant                | Object IDs from another tenant never yield unauthorized read/write/delete.                                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-008 | BFLA privilege escalation        | Normal users cannot invoke admin/KYC/payment/policy functions directly.                                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-009 | Mass assignment                  | Role, tenant, verified, amount, release, owner and other privileged fields cannot be set through crafted payloads. |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-010 | Tenant header manipulation       | Client-supplied tenant/workspace identifiers cannot escape membership scope.                                       |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-011 | Stale authorization              | Revoked role/membership is effective before consequential action.                                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-012 | KYC direct-state bypass          | No API/UI payload can set verified state without authorized transition.                                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-013 | KYC callback spoof/replay        | Unsigned, stale, duplicate or wrong-case provider callbacks are rejected/ignored safely.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-014 | Identity evidence substitution   | Replacing files/data after verification does not preserve invalid verified state.                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-015 | Rate-limit evasion               | IP/account/device/tenant variations do not trivially bypass sensitive flow quotas.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-016 | AI cost abuse                    | Concurrent/high-token/tool calls are bounded by quota, budget and backpressure.                                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-017 | Archive bomb / upload DoS        | Decompression, size and processing caps prevent resource exhaustion.                                               |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-018 | MIME/polyglot upload             | Mismatch/unsafe formats are quarantined/rejected; no upload executes from storage.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-019 | Malware upload                   | Known malicious test artifact is blocked/quarantined and emits security telemetry.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-020 | SSRF metadata/private network    | URL-fetching tools cannot access cloud metadata, loopback, link-local or unauthorized RFC1918 targets.             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-021 | Redirect SSRF                    | Allowed URL redirecting to blocked target is revalidated and stopped.                                              |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-022 | Prompt injection - direct        | User content cannot instruct agent to bypass policy, expose secrets or widen permissions.                          |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-023 | Prompt injection - indirect      | Retrieved file/web content cannot authorize tool calls or exfiltrate protected context.                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-024 | Tool parameter tampering         | Model-generated/crafted tool arguments are schema and authorization checked server-side.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-025 | Cross-tenant retrieval injection | Prompt/document references cannot retrieve other-tenant files/search results.                                      |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-026 | Webhook spoof                    | Invalid payment/provider signatures never mutate financial/domain state.                                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-027 | Webhook replay                   | Duplicate/replayed provider event is idempotent and does not duplicate ledger/release.                             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-028 | Client amount manipulation       | Browser/API payload cannot alter approved amount/currency/recipient.                                               |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-029 | Duplicate release                | Retry, double click, concurrency and replay cannot produce more than one release.                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-030 | Stale-state release              | Release fails if dispute/status/approval changed after page load or earlier eligibility check.                     |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-031 | Beneficiary takeover             | Beneficiary change requires enhanced controls and cannot silently redirect pending release.                        |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-032 | Ledger mutation                  | Existing ledger entries cannot be edited/deleted through normal app/admin paths.                                   |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-033 | CSRF                             | Cookie-authenticated state-changing endpoints resist cross-site request forgery.                                   |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-034 | CORS misconfiguration            | Untrusted origins cannot read credentialed protected APIs.                                                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-035 | Injection                        | SQL/command/template injection suites pass for relevant parsers/queries.                                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-036 | Secrets exposure                 | Secrets absent from client bundles, logs, error responses, analytics and model prompts.                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-037 | API inventory                    | Deprecated/debug/internal endpoints are not unintentionally exposed in production.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-038 | Third-party unsafe consumption   | Malformed/hostile integrated API response cannot bypass validation or corrupt domain state.                        |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-039 | Privilege audit completeness     | Every privileged/consequential action emits attributable audit evidence.                                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-040 | Abuse flow simulation            | Invite, messaging, booking, proposal, review, dispute and export flows resist automated spam/resource abuse.       |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-001 | Account enumeration              | Login/reset/verification responses and timings do not disclose account existence beyond accepted risk.             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-002 | Credential stuffing              | Automated password attempts trigger layered controls without enabling easy account-lockout DoS.                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-003 | MFA replay/bypass                | OTP/passkey challenges cannot be replayed; sensitive actions enforce current assurance.                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-004 | Session fixation                 | Session identifiers/authority rotate appropriately after authentication/privilege changes.                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-005 | Refresh token reuse              | Reused stolen refresh credential is detected/invalidated or equivalent protection demonstrated.                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-006 | Recovery takeover                | Password/account recovery cannot bypass MFA/identity policy through alternate endpoints.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-007 | BOLA cross-tenant                | Object IDs from another tenant never yield unauthorized read/write/delete.                                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-008 | BFLA privilege escalation        | Normal users cannot invoke admin/KYC/payment/policy functions directly.                                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-009 | Mass assignment                  | Role, tenant, verified, amount, release, owner and other privileged fields cannot be set through crafted payloads. |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-010 | Tenant header manipulation       | Client-supplied tenant/workspace identifiers cannot escape membership scope.                                       |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-011 | Stale authorization              | Revoked role/membership is effective before consequential action.                                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-012 | KYC direct-state bypass          | No API/UI payload can set verified state without authorized transition.                                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-013 | KYC callback spoof/replay        | Unsigned, stale, duplicate or wrong-case provider callbacks are rejected/ignored safely.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-014 | Identity evidence substitution   | Replacing files/data after verification does not preserve invalid verified state.                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-015 | Rate-limit evasion               | IP/account/device/tenant variations do not trivially bypass sensitive flow quotas.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-016 | AI cost abuse                    | Concurrent/high-token/tool calls are bounded by quota, budget and backpressure.                                    |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-017 | Archive bomb / upload DoS        | Decompression, size and processing caps prevent resource exhaustion.                                               |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-018 | MIME/polyglot upload             | Mismatch/unsafe formats are quarantined/rejected; no upload executes from storage.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-019 | Malware upload                   | Known malicious test artifact is blocked/quarantined and emits security telemetry.                                 |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-020 | SSRF metadata/private network    | URL-fetching tools cannot access cloud metadata, loopback, link-local or unauthorized RFC1918 targets.             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-021 | Redirect SSRF                    | Allowed URL redirecting to blocked target is revalidated and stopped.                                              |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-022 | Prompt injection - direct        | User content cannot instruct agent to bypass policy, expose secrets or widen permissions.                          |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-023 | Prompt injection - indirect      | Retrieved file/web content cannot authorize tool calls or exfiltrate protected context.                            |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-024 | Tool parameter tampering         | Model-generated/crafted tool arguments are schema and authorization checked server-side.                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-025 | Cross-tenant retrieval injection | Prompt/document references cannot retrieve other-tenant files/search results.                                      |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-026 | Webhook spoof                    | Invalid payment/provider signatures never mutate financial/domain state.                                           |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-027 | Webhook replay                   | Duplicate/replayed provider event is idempotent and does not duplicate ledger/release.                             |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-028 | Client amount manipulation       | Browser/API payload cannot alter approved amount/currency/recipient.                                               |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-029 | Duplicate release                | Retry, double click, concurrency and replay cannot produce more than one release.                                  |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-030 | Stale-state release              | Release fails if dispute/status/approval changed after page load or earlier eligibility check.                     |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-031 | Beneficiary takeover             | Beneficiary change requires enhanced controls and cannot silently redirect pending release.                        |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-032 | Ledger mutation                  | Existing ledger entries cannot be edited/deleted through normal app/admin paths.                                   |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-033 | CSRF                             | Cookie-authenticated state-changing endpoints resist cross-site request forgery.                                   |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-034 | CORS misconfiguration            | Untrusted origins cannot read credentialed protected APIs.                                                         |
assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

assessmentUnit: reviewed topic; not an independent per-line compliance verdict

text: | SEC-036 | Secrets exposure                 | Secrets absent from client bundles, logs, error responses, analytics and model prompts.                            |
